key_insight: Metadata-Driven AI keeps raw data away from the LLM and turns natural-language analyses into reusable programs, paying inference costs at generation rather than on every run.
engineering_relevance: For photovoltaic site prospection, this pattern can support repeatable analysis over live geospatial APIs without sending underlying datasets to the model.
method: Send only metadata across a one-way inference boundary to the LLM.
Generate an analysis program and execute it next to the data.
Retain the program for reuse without repeated LLM inference.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a cost model, metadata-transfer measurements on public datasets, a small locally hosted model benchmark, and three applications including photovoltaic prospection, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Generated programs still require validation for correctness and safe execution, especially when source APIs or metadata change.
paper_title: Metadata-Driven AI: An Architectural Pattern for Sustainable Data Analysis with LLMs
